BiblicalUsage: Kareah is the father of Johanan and Jonathan, captains who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah after the fall of Jerusalem, and who heard of all the evil Ishmael had done. They came to Gedaliah when the king of Babylon made him governor.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the name as the mark of a family that stood by the remnant when the kingdom had fallen.
